paragraphs: SteelCloud sells ConfigOS, a platform its pages describe as automating system hardening, remediation, continuous monitoring and compliance reporting. The stated scope is policy compliance work against STIG, CIS and CMMC, applied in any environment and for either private or public cybersecurity effort.

The homepage says the platform has been implemented throughout the Department of Defense in classified and unclassified environments, tactical programs, weapon systems, disconnected labs and cloud applications. Another line places the product with federal, SLED and regulated enterprise organizations.

The same page describes ConfigOS as relied upon by system integrators, national security organizations and regulated enterprises. ConfigOS is presented as scanning endpoints across enterprise, cloud and classified environments and executing hardened configurations across hundreds of controls.

quote.text: ConfigOS unifies baseline customization, implementation and enforcement into a single automation platform.
